content: Babse-goled-neg-soblegedga ibmar uklesad

Rey-David, bela dulemar-igar-itobukwamaladga sogded: “Bab-Dummad an-machi-Salomón ega arbaed-dummad-imakega nug-imaksad. Degi-inigwele, an-machi amba sapingwasoggua, we-ibmar-dummad-imakegala, amba nue ibmar wissulid. Ar neg-soblegoedi, dulega soblegosulid, ar Bab-Dummadga soblegoed.
An Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-sobega ibmarmar-bukidar-onmakega, an dummad-gar-itonai gusad.

content.text: degi, akwa-mármol-bukidar ibmar-soblegoedgi ebulegega an urbisbalid.

content: ”An Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg nuekwaa sobedgi an binsasoggua, we-ibmarmar-onmaksad-ukine, an ibmarmar-nuegan-nikadgi, an bela ormar-nikadi, manimar-nikadi, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggala an ukbalid.

content.text: Bela we-ormar, manimar, dule e-argangi ibmar-akar-akar sobegalad.
Bemarmoga, emi-ibagine, ¿doa-dule Bab-Jehováʼga na binsa e-ibmar-ukmogoe?”
degi, esgoro, nibir miyon-gwensak gaka mili-dulataled-ilagugle-gaka-dulabo-gakambe (1,750,000) uksamalad.

content: Dulemar bela akwa-nuegan-gargermalad-nikamalad Gersón-wagwa-Jehielʼga uksamalad. Jehiel, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi ibmar-gargermalad-akwediid.
Deyobi, dulemar na war-wargwengi ibmar-uksamaladba yeer-itosmalad, ar ade, Bab-Jehováʼga bela-bela na weligwaledba uksamalad.
Rey-David Bab-Jehováʼse gochad
Degidbali, Rey-David nue-yeer-itosmogad. Geb, David, bela dulemar-danar-bukwad-asabin Bab-Jehová-e-nug-odummonai gualid. Weyob sogded:

content.text: Anmar-Bab-Dummadye, agala, anmar bega dog-nuedye sogbalid,
Emide, nabir ibmar-bukidar bega ukye soged.
Ar anmardi be-anmarga-ibmar-uksad, gannar anmar bega uknaid.
Ar anmar be-asabinni, we-napneggi negsuli an gudimalad,
Agala, an gwage-islidikidgi bela an bega ibmarmar uksad.
Emide an daked, dulemar ibiyobi ulubgi weligwaledba bega ibmar uksamala.
Bitigi be, be-dulamar-weyob-binsaed, degi, weyob-ibmar-imakedi, mer osulogena gadin.
Deginbali, be-dulamar bela-bela bebina-soged, mer bergubalina gadin.
Deyopira, be an-machi-Salomónʼgala, gwage-nued be uksamogana gadin,
bitigi an-machi-Salomón, an-ibmarmar-onmaksadgi, bese-goled-neg-sobed-obelogega be imaksabalina gadin.”

content: Degine, geb David bela-dulemar-bukwadga sogded: “Be-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-nug be odummomarsun.” Degidgi, bela-dulemar-bukwad, e-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-e-nug odummosmalad. Agine, Bab-Jehová-asabin, degi, rey-asabin napase dulluu imaksamalad.
Salomón reyga megnonikid

content.text: Neg-oibosadgine, Israel-dulemar-nuggine, Bab-Jehováʼga we-ibmar-durgan oburgwismalad, degi, ega ogumakar uksamarbalid:

content: A-ibagine, Israel-dulemar, Salomón-e-nonogine olivo-gwallu eosmalad, adi, Salomón David-sorba reyga megegar. Deyob Sadocʼgi olivo-gwallu eosmarbalid, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga onug-imakmalagar. Israel-dulemala, wese-ilabogus deyob Salomón-imakdanimalad, adi, oyogega reyga gunoniye. Degidbali, bela weligwaledba Bab-Jehová-asabin gobsamalad, degi, mas-guchamarbalid.
Degine, Salomón, e-bab-David-sorba Bab-Jehová-gangi reyga signonisunnad. Degidgine, Salomón bela-bela nasgusad. Israel-dulemar belagwable Salomón-sogedba bela ibmar-imakbukwa gusmalad.
Bela dule-dummagan, dule-gandikmalad, degi, Rey-David-e-masmala, Salomón-reyga-megisad yeerdaksamalad, eba nanadii gusmalad.

Degi, Bab-Jehová, Israel-dulemar-asabin bela-bela Salomón-e-nug odummosad, e-yar-semaid bela-bela ogannosbalid. Salomón-iduale, rey-baid Salomónʼyobid gandikidba-yeerdaklege Israel-yargi yar-semai gussulid.
Rey-David-burgwisad
Isaí-machi-David, bela-Israel-dulemarga yar-semai-gusad.
Israel-yargi bela birga-dulabo (40) yar-sesad. Hebrón-neggweburgi birgagugle (7) yar-sesad, degi, Jerusalén-neggweburgi birga-dulagwen-gakambe-gakapaa (33) yar-sesad.
David nue-selebagusadgi burgwisad. Ibmar-nuegan-bukidar-nika, degi, nug-dummarba-nika burgwisad. Geb a-sorbali, e-machi-Salomón yar-seega megnonikid.

Bela-Rey-David-gebe-ibmar-imakded, degi, napi-ibmar-imaksadse, Bab-Dummad-negburgan-daked-Samuel neggusad-gardagi narmakar maid, degi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Natán neggusad-gardagi narmakar maibalid, degi, Bab-Dummadgi-negburgan-daked-Gad neggusad-gardagi narmakar maibalid.
Bela Rey-David-e-negsesad, e-gangu-megisad, e-gudigusad, degi, Israel-dulemargi-ibmar-gusmalad, bela yar-baigangi neg-gusmarbalidi, we-gardamargi narmakar nanaid.
